title: Időpontfoglalás és sorszámhúzás a Kormányablakban
grammar: Administrative Syntax: Appointment Booking & Queue Protocol

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say that I booked an appointment for a day and time at the government window.
I can follow a number display and see which window to go to.
I can understand short sentences about waiting and queuing.
